title: Vanilla Renewed+
description: This Modpack is fully client side, it improves the game with many quality of life changes and useful features.
body:
![Vanilla renewed+](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84631cb54db8eea1ee725b69c0dc83f517a95dbb.jpeg)

**Aiming to make the best client side modpack**

This modpack is entirely client-side, meaning it works on any server without causing compatibility issues. It enhances the game with numerous quality-of-life features and detailed texture upgrades, making every aspect of the game feel more polished and immersive.
